about.aboutIntro: Thrive Portal is a unified academic management environment designed to connect education center administrators, teachers, students, and parents with complete transparency and real-time efficiency.
about.sectionStudentsDesc: Students can log in to view their up-to-date weekly class schedule, track attendance, check grades and scores for every lesson, submit assignments digitally, and receive direct teacher feedback.
about.sectionTeachersDesc: Faculty members can manage their assigned groups, mark student attendance in seconds with past-date security locks, evaluate daily academic performance, and assign or review homework.
about.sectionParentsDesc: Parents have 24/7 visibility into their child's educational progress, attendance records, exam results, teacher feedback, and tuition payment history — all in a single intuitive interface.
about.featureSyncDesc: All records are synchronized directly with the center's central database, ensuring teachers, students, and parents always see accurate and verified information.

prep.title: ThrivePrep — Autonomous AI Self-Study Ecosystem
prep.subtitle: Adaptive digital test simulation, real-time mistake diagnostic radar, and intelligent spaced-repetition practice for SAT, IELTS, AP, and Olympiads.
prep.satSimulatorDesc: Module 1 & 2 difficulty adaptation, Desmos graphing integration, and authentic College Board algorithm simulation.
prep.ieltsAiDesc: Instant lexical resource, grammatical range, and coherence scoring with voice pronunciation feedback.
prep.weakPointRadarDesc: Automatic sub-topic mistake classification and targeted micro-drills to eliminate score plateaus.
prep.spacedRepetitionDesc: AI-curated high-frequency SAT vocabulary and formula mastery cards with optimal recall scheduling.
prep.fullSimulatorsDesc: Proctored environment with live countdown, question flagging, score predictors, and national percentile calculation.
prep.gamifiedStreakDesc: Daily target streaks, XP rewards, and live peer benchmarking across academic cohorts.
